literal: Mingling he-who-is-without life, pond's-expanse bank without water having-filled like-that.
translation: The life of one who does not mingle intimately with his kindred is like a vast pond filling with water without a bank to hold it.
modern: சுற்றத்தாருடன் மனம் விட்டுப் பழகும் தன்மை இல்லாதவனின் வாழ்க்கையானது, கரையில்லாத ஒரு பெரிய குளத்தில் நீர் நிறைவதைப் போன்றது.
explanation: This couplet compares the life of a person who lacks intimacy with their relatives to a vast pond that has no banks. Just as water flowing into a bankless pond simply runs off and is wasted without benefiting anyone, the wealth and life of someone who does not embrace their kindred will not be sustained or useful. The word 'அளவளா' refers to mingling freely and intimately, highlighting the emotional bond needed to hold a family together, much like a bank holds water.
